To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a self-attention mechanism to model the relations between categorical features in multi-field data and apply it to learn the representations of feature combinations.

(1) self-attention can be used to learn representations of feature combinations in categorical data, which is known as factorization; (2) the proposed top-k restricted selfattention further improves the effect of factorization.
we propose a self-attention based model to learn representations of non-sequential categorical feature combinations, which can achieve the state-of-the-arts on CTR prediction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following two aspects: 1) applying self-attention mechanism to model dependencies of non-sequential data; 2) mining representations of feature combinations via self-attention.
the fundamental problem of how to model the relations of categorical features in different fields.
how to model the dependencies of categorical data and learn the representations of their combinations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed self-attention mechanism is an effective way to model the feature combination in categorical data and can be used in a variety of tasks.

the proposed self-attention mechanism is effective in learning representations of feature combinations in non-sequential data and the top-k restricted self attention is an effective way to regularize the model.

the proposed self-attention model is a promising approach to learning representations of categorical features and their combinations, which can be applied in many other tasks beyond click through rate prediction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
self-attention can be applied to non-sequences to learn representations of feature combinations, and it can further be improved by restricting the number of non-zero weights in self-attention.
, we are able, for the first time, to use self-attention to mine the feature combinations and learn the representations of them.
, by applying self attention to non-sequential feature combinations, we can achieve the state-of-the art performance in CTR prediction task.
The main takeaway from our work is that
self-attention can be a powerful tool for learning feature combinations in non-sequential data and can be applied to a wider range of applications.
self-attention can effectively capture the relations between feature combinations and improve the performance of prediction tasks.
self-attention can also be applied to non- sequential data and achieve remarkable improvements.
